releaseNote.zh-cn:
1. 修复 特定情况下对播放队列重新排序可能失败或导致崩溃
  2. 修复 部分设备上在媒体扫描期间切换标签页偶发崩溃
  3. 修复 部分设备上应用处于后台时切换系统深色模式导致崩溃
  4. 修复 解析多音乐标签时可能存在末尾空格残留
  5. 新增 支持全屏查看专辑封面
  6. 优化 卡片播放器同样添加可选的顶部渐变遮罩，以提升可读性
  7. 翻译 更新德语 (jande75)
  8. 开发 使用 JDK 25 和 Gradle 9.5.1 构建, 更新依赖
releaseNote.en:
1. Fix: reordering playing queue may fail or cause crashes under some circumstances
  2. Fix: occasional crashes when switching tabs during media scanning on some devices
  3. Fix: crash when toggling system dark mode while the app is in the background on some devices
  4. Fix: possibly trailing spaces remained in the parsed multiple music tags
  5. New: full-screen image viewer for album artwork
  6. Improve: add an optional top gradient scrim to the Card player as well, to enhance legibility
  7. Translation: update German (by jande75)
  8. Development: build with JDK 25 and Gradle 9.7.1, update dependencies
